## Insure the Class

<!-- The QR code is switched by `show.dice-qr` in _quarto.yml. Every step has
     a fragment index (bullets 1-3, question 4, QR code 5) so the QR code
     appears last; reveal.js shows indexed steps before unindexed ones. -->

:::: {.columns .rules-layout}
::: {.column .rules-text}
You run a phone insurance company. A claim costs **$600**.

::: {.rules-steps}
::: {.fragment fragment-index="1"}
- Every customer is the same: roll a die, and **a 1 means a claim** (a 1 in 6 chance).
:::
::: {.fragment fragment-index="2"}
- Each team secretly sets a **premium** (fee to charge your customer). Customers go to the cheapest insurer.
:::
::: {.fragment fragment-index="3"}
- Roll for each customer, then tally your profit and loss.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.content-visible when-meta="show.dice-qr"}
::: {.column .rules-qr .fragment fragment-index="5"}
![](images/qr-dice.png){.qr .qr-small fig-alt="QR code linking to the on-screen dice page"}
[Scan to roll the virtual die on your phone]{.caption-line}
:::
:::
::::

::: {.keyphrase .fragment .zoom-in fragment-index="4"}
What premium should you charge? Write it down now: no changing later!
:::
